description: Physicians and MAs review the chart; document visits; place lab orders; review results
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergies, medications, and results unavailable); about $4,400 revenue per clinic day; about 40 visits per day would need rescheduling after one day
manual_workaround: Paper visit forms and printed next-day schedule; see urgent and established patients only; defer new-patient visits
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; reference laboratory (via EHR lab interface); internet provider; MSP

description: Book appointments; register patients; verify insurance eligibility
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Front desk stops without the schedule; eligibility errors cause denied claims
manual_workaround: Printed next-day schedule; paper registration form; payer phone lines for eligibility
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; clearinghouse (eligibility, through the EHR vendor); internet provider

description: New prescriptions and refill requests, including controlled substances
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients cannot get medications; controlled-substance e-prescribing depends on the EHR's certified module
manual_workaround: Phone or paper prescriptions where federal and state law allow; defer routine refills 1 day
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; e-prescribing network (through the EHR vendor)

description: Run ECG and spirometry tests; import results into the EHR
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tests can be rescheduled or referred; results are imported the same day, so up to one day of local results could be lost
manual_workaround: ECG machine prints a paper tracing; refer spirometry to the hospital outpatient lab

business_process: Referrals, records requests, and faxed results
description: Send and receive referrals, prior authorizations, outside records, and faxed results
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Referral and prior-authorization deadlines; outside results must reach physicians
manual_workaround: Physicians call specialists directly; ask senders to re-send once restored (faxes queue at the vendor)
dependent_third_parties: Cloud fax vendor; productivity suite vendor

description: Charge review; claim submission through the EHR's clearinghouse; payment posting; patient statements
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $21,000 billed per week; payers accept late claims within filing limits
manual_workaround: Queue charges in the EHR; submit when restored; payer portals for urgent claims; cash reserve covers 30 days

description: Phone calls; patient portal messages; appointment reminders; email with outside providers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients need to reach the office for urgent symptoms and results
manual_workaround: Forward office line to the Office Manager's cell phone; after-hours message points to urgent care or 911
dependent_third_parties: Phone carrier; EHR vendor; productivity suite vendor

description: Shared-drive documents (forms, scanned records awaiting import, billing worksheets); HR files; payroll through an outside payroll service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; scanned outside records awaiting import are needed for care within days
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll service; request re-sends of scanned records
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; backup service (MSP subcontractor); MSP; payroll service
